A positive attitude can't do everything. Kevin says so himself.

Someone once told Kevin Trudeau he must think a positive attitude can do anything. Kevin disagreed. You can't wish yourself into a heavyweight title or float off a building.

What a positive attitude can do is make everything you try go better than a negative one would. Kevin points to Napoleon Hill: you can only achieve what you can actually believe.

That is a more honest way to look at belief, and a more useful one.

What is something you could believe in fully, starting today?

#ad #mindset #success

They controlled everything except his thoughts.

Kevin Trudeau talks about reading Viktor Frankl's Man's Search for Meaning. Frankl lived through a Nazi concentration camp with little food and long days of forced labor.

Frankl said that others controlled everything in his life except one thing: his thoughts. Kevin says that idea changed how he looked at his own situation, and he felt lucky.

It is a matter of perspective, and perspective is a choice.

What would change if you saw your life this way?

#ad #mindset #happiness #freedom

Why the wealthy get fed up before they get moving.

Kevin Trudeau says he spends his time around very wealthy people, not success gurus. He tells of texting a man who owns a fleet of private planes, who called right back and talked planes for half an hour.

What Kevin notices is that people like that get fed up, and they use it. To move energy and define what you want, he says, you first have to know what you don't want.

What are you truly fed up with right now?
